name: Pistmon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If you have 3 or more security cards, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. It can't unsuspend during your opponent's next unsuspend phase. If you have 3 or fewer security cards, gain 2 memory.
source_effect: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Pulsemon] in its text, by trashing the top card of your security stack, unsuspend this Digimon.
